decisions.reason: As the modular continuation of a proven trommel platform, it fits the installed-base business and likely costs little to keep, making near-term withdrawal unlikely.
The mobile high-speed grinder stays close to the core mobile processing portfolio, but after several years its remaining option value is more niche-dependent, so rationalization risk is moderate.
The green-waste grinder serves a recognizable segment and can likely be maintained with limited incremental cost, though overlap with broader grinder offerings leaves some consolidation risk.
The stationary single-shaft pre-shredder line complements the firm's stationary systems business and by now looks more like an established extension than an experiment to abandon.
